title: Agreement preserves a segment
statement: Let $\mu,\mu':\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $l$ be a finite list of integers. If $\mu(a+i)$ equals the $i$th entry of $l$ for every index $i$ within the list, and $\mu'(a+i)=\mu(a+i)$ for every such index, then $\mu'(a+i)$ also equals the $i$th entry of $l$ throughout the list.
hypotheses_covered: The values of $\mu$ on the indexed segment equal the entries of $l$
The values of $\mu'$ and $\mu$ agree on that segment
